gloss: lineup; all key figures appearing together

definitions.gloss: lineup; all key figures appearing together
definitions.explanation: An occasion on which all the important or expected people gather and appear together. Originally a sumo term for wrestlers stamping in unison.

examples.japanese: スターが{揃|そろ}い{踏|ぶ}みした。
{人気|にんき}{選手|せんしゅ}の{揃|そろ}い{踏|ぶ}みに{観客|かんきゃく}が{沸|わ}いた。
examples.english: The crowd was thrilled by the lineup of popular players.

examples.japanese: {今回|こんかい}の{会議|かいぎ}には{各国|かっこく}の{首脳|しゅのう}が{揃|そろ}い{踏|ぶ}みした。
examples.english: At this conference, the leaders of every country appeared together.

notes:
Originally a sumo term for the ceremonial stamping ({四股|しこ}) that wrestlers perform together before a bout. Now used broadly when all the notable or expected figures gather in one place. Takes する to form a verb.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {揃|そろ}い{踏|ぶ}みする: to all appear together
- {豪華|ごうか}な{揃|そろ}い{踏|ぶ}み: a star-studded lineup

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {勢揃|せいぞろ}い: a full gathering — similar, emphasizing a complete assembly of people
- ラインナップ: lineup — loanword, used for a planned roster of products or members

cross_references.label: to be complete, to be uniform
